{"content":"apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: application-deployment
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: application
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: application
    spec:
      securityContext:
        # While we keep the intention of a read-only root filesystem, 
        # the container must be allowed specific writable paths.
        # Note: If the application failed *because* of RORFS, simply setting RORFS=true 
        # often fails if logs/temp writes are attempted. We allow the application
        # to run with the strict root FS, but provide volumes for necessary writes.
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true 
      containers:
      - name: application-container
        image: my-application-image:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        # Mount paths where the application is expected to write
        volumeMounts:
        - name: writable-data
          mountPath: /var/lib/app/data # Example data path
        - name: writable-logs
          mountPath: /var/log # Example log path
      volumes:
      - name: writable-data
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: writable-logs
        emptyDir: {}","path":"deployment.yaml"}
